label: Krabi
short_description: Resorts on the Andaman coast of limestone cliffs, islands and quiet coves.
intro: Krabi's coverage in this directory is on Thailand's Andaman coast, a landscape of dramatic limestone karsts, mangroves and island-hopping beaches around Ao Nang, Railay and the offshore isles. Quieter and more scenic than Phuket across the bay, Krabi suits secluded beach-and-nature stays and is reached via Krabi International Airport (KBV).
